content.user_title: Create Ad Copy and Grounded Creative Concepts
content.value_statement: Ad teams need distinct creative variations that respect platform limits and reflect real customer evidence. This skill structures copy generation, performance-based iteration, and stakeholder review.
actual_capabilities: Draft headlines, descriptions, and primary text with platform-specific character counts and trimmed alternatives.
Analyze supplied performance data to identify winning themes and propose new variations.
Structure static creative batches around customer reviews, winning ads, and comments with source citations.
Plan creative roadmaps and test hypotheses using performance, customer language, and organic signals.
Populate the included HTML review template with Instagram and Facebook mockups, storyboard frames, and selectable headlines.
Provide video scripts, visual prompts, and production specifications through specialized reference guides.
limitations: Image, video, voice, and ad-account integrations require separately configured tools, credentials, and potentially paid services.
Grounded static batches require real source material; the skill stops when required winning ads or reviews are missing.
Creative recommendations cannot guarantee conversions, platform approval, legal compliance, or future performance.
Platform specifications and provider pricing can change; verify current requirements before production.

use_cases.title: Prepare Search Ad Variations
use_cases.description: Draft independent Google Ads headlines and complementary descriptions around approved product benefits.

use_cases.title: Refresh Proven Creative
use_cases.description: Use performance exports to extend successful themes, avoid weak patterns, and define measurable creative tests.

use_cases.title: Present Grounded Concepts
use_cases.description: Turn customer evidence and brand assets into source-linked concepts and a visual review page for client approval.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Your First Search Ads
prompt_templates.prompt: Write five Google Ads headlines and two descriptions for [product], targeting [audience]. Use only these approved facts: [facts]. Include character counts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create a small copy set from an approved brief.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Creative Angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft three Meta ad angles for [offer] using [customer evidence]. Provide two variations per angle, source citations, and platform character checks.

prompt_templates.title: Iterate From Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [performance export] using [primary metric]. Identify winning and losing patterns. Draft ten variations with measurable hypotheses against [control].
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: use real campaign results to guide iteration.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Grounded Creative Slate
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [winning ads], [reviews], [comments], and [brand assets]. Propose a capacity-checked creative slate with source citations and falsifiable hypotheses. Prepare a local review page.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate strategy, production planning, and stakeholder review.

output_examples.input: Create Google Ads headlines for a reporting tool with scheduled weekly reports and a free trial.
output: Benefit angle: Schedule Weekly Reports (23 characters).
Action angle: Try Weekly Reports Free (23 characters).
Each headline fits the 30-character limit and uses supplied product facts.

output_examples.input: Concept A has higher CTR than Concept B at similar spend. Propose one focused follow-up test.
output: Test a new opening headline based on Concept A while keeping the image and offer unchanged.
Hypothesis: the new headline increases CTR versus Concept A in the same audience.
Track conversions alongside CTR before selecting the next creative.

output_examples.input: Prepare a client review for three approved concepts with local images and verified customer quotes.
output: A local HTML review page presents each concept in Instagram and Facebook previews.
Storyboard frames, headline choices, and source disclosures support approval.
Missing images appear as labeled placeholders rather than fabricated product assets.

best_practices: Provide approved product facts, permitted customer quotes, brand assets, and the target platform before drafting.
Use source citations and measurable hypotheses; change one creative variable per test.
Review claims and permissions before sharing; authorize external services separately and escape embedded review data as instructed.
anti_patterns: Inventing testimonials, statistics, product benefits, or campaign results to complete a batch.
Treating minor wording changes as distinct creative angles or testing many variables simultaneously.
Publishing review pages or launching campaigns without checking confidential data, usage rights, and stakeholder approval.

faq.question: Which advertising platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It provides copy specifications for Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and Twitter/X. The included review template previews Instagram and Facebook.

faq.question: Does the skill generate images and videos by itself?
faq.answer: It supplies visual prompts and production guides. Rendering requires separately available image, video, voice, or code-based tools.

faq.question: Can I use existing campaign performance data?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a CSV, pasted results, or API output and identify the metric that should guide iteration.

faq.question: What inputs are required for grounded static batches?
faq.answer: Provide winning ads and customer reviews. Ad comments and brand assets add context. Missing required sources stop grounded generation.

faq.question: Does the review page launch ads or save approvals?
faq.answer: No. It displays concepts and selectable previews. It does not submit campaigns or provide a persistent approval backend.

faq.question: Does installation connect my advertising accounts?
faq.answer: No. Account access requires separate integration setup and authorization. Plain copy drafting can use supplied briefs without account connections.
